title: Crystal Ball Wanderer
description: A black and white line drawing depicts a backpacker with a walking stick standing on a rocky cliff, gazing up at a large glowing crystal ball containing three stylized alien-like faces. The surreal night scene includes a lavender field with glowing crystals and small figures on a hill, a large red celestial body with symbols and rings in the starry sky, and constellation lines.
prompt: Surreal black and white line art illustration on a solid black background. In the foreground, a lone hiker with backpack and walking stick stands on a rocky cliff looking upward. Centered is a large glowing purple crystal ball containing three stylized alien faces with large eyes, one smiling, one neutral, one shocked, wearing a geometric patterned top. Behind them is a hill covered in lavender flowers and glowing crystals with small figures walking. In the upper right, a large red planet with rings and alchemical symbols floats in a starry sky with constellation lines. Mystical and dreamlike atmosphere.
